scenario: LFCA.5 / LDIA.9.2 — `default` sets `series: true`, so a `series` declaration and a rule reading one of its aggregations compile under `use default` with no override. Drives `dsc.dialect`'s per-construct gate (`series_sites`) on the permitted side; LFCA.5_series_disabled_refuses pins the refused side.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    val: Float mutable
    ts: Time

series Sensor.val:
    mean sliding 10_min

rule check:
    Sensor s where s.mean > 5.0
->
    log info "high"
